description: This file defines search configuration for the 'Prospects' module in SuiteCRM, including layouts for basic and advanced searches with various search fields and conditional options based on configurator settings.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: A class responsible for managing configuration settings within SuiteCRM, such as checking if certain features like opt-in are enabled.

methods.name: Configurator::isConfirmOptInEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the confirmation opt-in feature is enabled in the system configuration.

methods.name: Configurator::isOptInEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the opt-in feature is enabled in the system configuration.

methods.name: get_user_array
methods.description: A function that retrieves an array of user options, typically for dropdown displays in the search layout.
